dialogueData.dialogue: [Sona beckons you forward. Are you ready?]
[Sona strungs a triumphant chord on her etwahl!]
[Sona gestures to Pentakill's instruments, inviting you to play.]
[Sona looks pleased with your playing.]
Prepared to play our killer music?
Perhaps you can join our choir...
You seem an eager pupil of metal.
This shall amplify your voice!
You earned our requiem. Now... a show of faith!
Yes—you may command the stage!
Land your chords with the crowd.
You have... potential.
Have you proven worthy to play?
Here. This will boost your basslines.
Perform again. Stir the soul.
...That was hardcore.
THROW THE SNOWBALL! HIT THEM HARD!
FUN. FUN!
MORE SNOWBALLS. MORE!
HAHA. AVALANCHE!
PLAY WITH US AT FULL POWER!
GLORY TO PENTAKILL! WELCOME TO THE BAND!
Audition for us, initiate.
Very well. You may follow our lead.

dialogueData.dialogue: Playing with us? You better keep up.
Fine. You're pretty cool, I guess.
Whatcha got? New songs, styles? ...Snacks?
Haha, style it is! This'll help ya hone it.
Whatever you bring, it better hit hard.
Not bad. But you gotta get more reps in.
Even now, we're not gonna go easy on you.
...But good to see you're not holding back, either.
C'mon, keep the hits goin'!
That's what I'm talkin' about!
You must be resilient to last in the industry.
Hmm... I would like to see more from you.
If the world wounds you, turn the pain into music.
I look forward to our continued collaboration.
Let's get you in the booth.
Excellent. Working with you inspires confidence.
Alright, hot shot, show us what you're made of.
Okay, you got talent!
We don't play by the industry's rules.
Now you can break the rules, too.
[Aphelios waves you over for an audition.]
[Aphelios smiles—and shares ideas for a new song.]
Give our fans everything you've got!
HEARTSTEEL is proud to call you a member!
...[It's a headphone, it can't speak]

dialogueData.dialogue: Show me you can slow it down.
Mhm, I saw. You've got good rhythm.
Do you really think we're warming up to you?
...Okay, we like you. But not as much as we love me.
Don't rush the process. Music takes time.
Your sound's got heart. You're cool with me.
Gotta be tough when the world wants to tear you down.
When the doubters get loud, you get louder.
Time's ticking until the concert. Ready for it?
Yeah, you're ready. Let's go!
The crowd won't know what hit 'em.
Sick. Now let's sharpen up the show.
We want someone who'll smash those records.
You're what TD's been lookin' for.
We speak our minds—better yet, sing 'em.
Got some pipes on you. Not bad.
A real artist takes risks.
Good, I don't share the stage with cowards.
You got an audition. Better stick the landing.
Alright... We're listening.
Lemme hear ya—loud 'n' lethal!
Made it big. Welcome to True Damage.
Truth, and trouble. That's what we bring.
Hah. Looks like you can keep up, kid.
...[It's a headphone, it can't speak]

dialogueData.dialogue: K/DA makes hits—never anything less.
I like what I hear. How far can you push it?
Aren't you precious? Keep singing, love.
Oh! You mean business. Okay, let's play.
You're a proven performer. But are you a star?
You're shining. The crowd is begging for more.
New sounds, new shows—the hits should never stop.
Amazing! Consider me charmed.
Hey, you again! K/DA's next level. Don't hold back.
Sweet, but... I feel like you got more to give.
Can you keep up with K/DA's choreo?
Take this—and push every performance.
Big concert comin' up. Here's your chance to go all out.
Oh yeah. I know talent when I see it.
Blow a kiss to the crowd—they're dying for it.
You've got flair, don't you?
Stay on top of your game, and we'll notice.
Here, the girls wanted to give you a gift.
Move to your own rhythm!
Quick, sharp—your style's nice!
Auditioning for us isn't for the faint of heart.
I'm intrigued... but not impressed just yet.
One more show. Give it your all!
Amazing! Welcome to K/DA, friend.
...[It's a headphone, it can't speak]

displayData.name: Worlds
displayData.lockedRequirement: Reach 8,800 Fame and wait for patch 26.22

dialogueData.dialogue: To truly shred, you must show no mercy.
Yes... a vicious performance.
Now, the final rehearsal before your Worlds debut.
You have gone far. One step more.
Stay quick. The industry's always moving.
You've got the world wrapped around your finger.
Worlds is a competition. Bring your A game.
You came to play. I like it.
Sharpen up, and the band'll stand behind you.
That's a start. Hone it.
When the whole group shines, so do you.
Killed it out there. You belong on stage.
Worlds rehearsals are intense. You up for 'em?
Nice. Keep up the practice.
Feel the energy? You made it to the Worlds stage!
Got the crowd callin' your name across the globe. Take it all in!
You must be there for your fellow bandmates.
Maybe you have the makings of a frontman!
Lead, harmonize, and our band will be the best!
The world will remember our show!
You must be versatile to work with all of us.
Take this, and try out a different style.
Music brings us together! That is why it matters.
It's an honor to collab with you!
SQUEE, squee squee! (I'm Security, and you're not on the list, bucko!)
